facts.fact: BCEAO Avis n°0019 of 2 October 2026 is binding from 2 November 2026 on interoperable e-money transactions and fees in the UEMOA including Benin.
BCEAO requires interoperable e-money transactions to go through PI-SPI from 2 November 2026, and UBA Benin says bank-wallet transfers are no longer possible outside it.
